verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms `GET https://api.cerebras.ai/v1/models` is a real, JSON-speaking, OpenAI-style endpoint (403 unauthenticated, not 404), and docs repeatedly assert OpenAI API compatibility and a public models catalog page (cerebras-docs-3, -4, -21). However, no first-party doc page explicitly documents the /v1/models endpoint schema/response, nor is there an OpenAPI spec (all openapi.json paths 404). missing for 10: explicit documented endpoint reference/response schema for /v1/models, no OpenAPI spec confirmation, no independent hands-on report of enumerating the catalog via this endpoint.
